sloka: स भग्न धन्वा विरथो हत अश्वो हत सारथिः ।अंकेन आदाय वैदेहीम् पपात भुवि रावणः ॥३-५१-१९॥
transliteration: sa bhagna dhanvā viratho hata aśvo hata sārathiḥ ।aṁkena ādāya vaidehīm papāta bhuvi rāvaṇaḥ ॥3-51-19॥

translations.english: Again the glorious, powerful king of birds swiftly shattered the huge head of the charioteer with his beak.
